leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the position: relative property to establish a positioning context for child elements
Configure the position: absolute property to precisely place elements within a relative container
Manipulate element placement using top, right, bottom, and left offset properties
Construct overlapping visual layouts by controlling the stacking order with z-index
Implement relative positioning to adjust an element's position without affecting document flow
Integrate absolute positioning to create positioned elements that scroll with their container
Initialize a positioning context by setting a parent element to position: relative
